anomalies.observed: The schematic labels PR4 as “LiDAR” and connects its H13 header to +5V, I2C_SDA, I2C_SCL, and GND.
anomalies.expected: The specification says the TF-Luna LiDAR is not wired into the design: its pins are free and it is documentation-only. The LiDAR interface should therefore be left unconnected.

evidence.quote: Sheet /, page 1: the WATER LEVEL SENSOR/SWITCHES section shows PR4 labeled “LiDAR”; H13 pins 1–4 connect respectively to VCC, NET0046, NET0051, and GND.
§4.3: “the r2 netlist shows PR1 with on_board: no, in_bom: yes, and all four pins (VCC, SDA, SCL, GND) typed free — i.e., it is not connected to any net in this design.”

anomalies.impact: The schematic provides a powered I2C connection for a LiDAR module despite the specified unwired, unimplemented status. If a module is connected, it will be powered and share the I2C bus even though the described firmware does not support it.

parsed.summary: The schematic connects a LiDAR-labeled module through H13 to power and the I2C bus, contradicting the specification’s explicit description of the LiDAR as unwired. The reference designations differ (PR4 in the drawing versus PR1 in the specification), but the LiDAR labeling and connected interface support the discrepancy.
